description: For a vault someone holds: does it DELIVER what it advertises, and which COMPARABLE vaults delivered more. `delivery` (free): realised yield (what the share price delivered, the /yield method) against the venue’s advertised rate over 30 and 90 days, the gap in points, the share of the promise delivered, the place on the realised board, the rolling 30-day line; where it cannot be measured, the reason in words, never a zero. `comparable`: vaults of the same asset class (the same token first), risk band the same or lower, an exit no worse (no longer notice, lock-up or queue; withdrawable share not lower by more than 10 points), big enough that the position would be at most 5% of them, scored, and not resting on one jump or on a book in a defunct market, that delivered MORE over BOTH 30 and 90 days (`better`), or about the same at a lower band (`safer`); up to three each, with `criteria` stating the rules and `place` the vault’s rank among them. Comparable vaults are a reading of past delivered yield, NOT a recommendation and not a forecast. FREE: delivery, counts, place, and per row only a difference range rounded to half a point, the network and curator kind at most (each withheld where fewer than three vaults would fit), and an estimate range on the position; names, links and exact figures need a plan (`capability`). positionUsd personalises the size floor and `extraPerYearUsd` (position times the smaller difference, an estimate).
